【服饰与材质系统】按季节、职业和经济条件建立家居服、工装、校服、普通衬衫、羽绒服: 【Costume and Material System】Build wardrobes of loungewear, workwear, school uniforms, plain shirts, down jackets and cloth shoes by season, occupation and economic conditions, keeping creases, wear and traces of repeated use; household items use neutralized real-brand design and a plausible service life, never brand-new display pieces.
【服饰与材质系统】按职业、收入、季节和性格建立西装、衬衫、针织、风衣及休闲装的角: 【Costume and Material System】Build each character's wardrobe of suits, shirts, knitwear, trench coats and casual wear by occupation, income, season and personality, with the main palette following the project color scheme; wool, cotton, leather, glass, metal and plastic keep realistic roughness, and a fixed character's signature garments and accessories form reusable assets.
【服饰与材质系统】服饰细节简化成大色块、粗线纹样和少量高光，棉、皮革、金属、牛仔: 【Costume and Material System】Simplify costume details into large color blocks, thick-line patterns and few highlights; cotton, leather, metal, denim and glass are told apart by line density and highlight shapes; combat or action outfits must allow movement.
【服饰与材质系统】服装按角色身份建立黑白灰明度差、纹理密度和轮廓结构，使用羊毛、: 【Costume and Material System】Costumes establish black-white-gray value differences, texture density and silhouette structure by character identity, using the real contrast of wool, cotton, leather, metal and glass; patterns do not rely on color and must be legible through material and value.
【服饰与材质系统】服装款式与纹样简化为可复用大色块，棉布、针织、牛仔、皮革和金属: 【Costume and Material System】Simplify garment styles and patterns into reusable large color blocks; cotton, knit, denim, leather and metal are told apart by a unified roughness range; props use moderately rounded edges and clear functional shapes, keeping scale, material and detail density consistent within the same world.
【服饰与材质系统】古代子类型按襟形、袖型、腰带、冠帽、鞋履和纹样建立制度；民国子: 【Costume & Material System】Period subtypes define rules by collar, sleeve, belt, headwear, footwear and pattern; Republican subtypes build class through qipao, changshan, student wear, military uniform and suits. Silk, linen, gauze, brocade, leather, wood, jade and metal share one material library; weapons, jewelry and objects must hold a definite era.
【服饰与材质系统】汉服、劲装、甲胄、宗门服和法器按身份与阵营形成款式库，固定衣领: 【Costume & Material System】Hanfu, martial wear, armor, sect robes and ritual implements form a style library by identity and faction, with fixed collar, sleeve, waist seal, pattern and color scheme; silk, hemp, metal and jade differ through 2D texture, line density and highlight shape, with no 3D realistic material maps.
【服饰与材质系统】建立舱内工作服、战术航天服、舰队制服、外交礼服和维修装模块，统: 【Costume & Material System】Build modules for onboard workwear, tactical space suits, fleet uniforms, diplomatic dress and maintenance gear, all using composite fiber, ceramic, metal, clear visors and soft seals; ports, fasteners, insignia and life-support units follow functional logic.
【服饰与材质系统】建立机能夹克、防水层、企业制服、旧式工装和改装配件库，统一使用: 【Costume & Material System】Build a library of techwear jackets, waterproof layers, corporate uniforms, old workwear and mod accessories, all in worn nylon, rubber, old leather, oxidized metal, clear plastic and low-lumen electronics; clothing must allow movement, pack down and suit the weather.
【服饰与材质系统】建立宽肩西装、衬衫、针织、牛仔、风衣、连衣裙和工装衣橱，使用真: 【Costume & Material System】Build a wardrobe of broad-shoulder suits, shirts, knits, denim, trench coats, dresses and workwear in real cotton, wool, leather, polyester and metal hardware; cut, pattern, buttons, footwear and carried items lock to a definite era.
【服饰与材质系统】建立棉麻、针织、旧牛仔、雨具、工作服、帆布鞋与草帽衣橱，材质保: 【Costume & Material System】Build a wardrobe of cotton-linen, knits, worn denim, rain gear, work clothes, canvas shoes and straw hats, with fabrics keeping creases, dirt, sweat and wear; recurring characters' coats, bags and handmade objects become signature assets.
【服饰与材质系统】建立模块化工作服、防护服、通勤装和轻型外骨骼体系，统一使用哑光: 【Costume & Material System】Build modular workwear, protective suits, commuter wear and light exoskeletons from matte technical fabric, titanium, ceramic, clear polymer and precision glass; seams, buckles, sensors and wear points must follow usage logic.
【服饰与材质系统】建立深色哑光外套、制服、便装和职业服饰库，通过剪裁、磨损和材质: 【Costume & Material System】Build a library of dark matte coats, uniforms, casual wear and professional dress, distinguishing roles by cut, wear and material; IDs, comms devices, files, surveillance gear and key props share one design language, avoiding high-gloss materials that break the dark palette.
【服饰与材质系统】袍服、劲装、甲胄、披风、宗门纹样、发冠与法器构成阵营化资产库；: 【Costume & Material System】Robes, martial wear, armor, capes, sect patterns, hair crowns and ritual implements form a faction-based asset library; silk, brocade, leather, metal, jade and wood share one PBR standard and roughness range, with stable structure for weapons, pendants and garment layers.
【服饰与材质系统】现实服装遵循生活逻辑，梦境服装可以通过重复、倒置、透明、过大或: 【Costume & Material System】Real-world clothing follows lived logic; dream clothing may express psychology through repetition, inversion, transparency, oversizing or undersizing, while fabric, buttons, footwear and signature objects stay as traceable variants.
【服饰与材质系统】衣服使用布料、针织、皮革、木扣、纸张和毛线等可触摸材质，纹样简: 【Costume & Material System】Clothing uses touchable materials such as cloth, knit, leather, wooden buttons, paper and yarn, with patterns reduced to a few repeated elements; signature character objects, collars, cuffs and footwear stay consistent.
【服饰与材质系统】衣物使用薄黏土、布料、毛线、纸张与细金属件组合，木、石、玻璃和: 【Costume & Material System】Clothing combines thin clay, cloth, yarn, paper and fine metal parts, with wood, stone, glass and food simulated in miniature; each material keeps readable grain, thickness and handmade edges, avoiding a uniform plastic surface.
【服饰与材质系统】长衫、袍服、斗笠、披风、兵器和文房器物通过墨线疏密、干湿变化与: 【Costume & Material System】Long gowns, robes, conical hats, capes, weapons and scholar's objects are distinguished by ink-line density, wet-dry variation and limited patterns; recurring characters' collars, belts, hair ornaments and key props keep clear shapes, and clothing may blend into the brushwork without losing structure.
【建筑世界观】古代子类型使用中式木构、斗拱、瓦顶、院落、回廊、园林和城镇体系；民: 【Architecture Worldview】Period subtypes use Chinese timber frames, bracket sets, tile roofs, courtyards, corridors, gardens and towns; Republican subtypes use shikumen lanes, arcades, mansions, stations, newspaper offices and old streets. The project enables only the chosen era's building library, with consistent period feel and wear on wood, brick, stone and plaster.
【建筑世界观】使用可快速识别的街区、商店、学校、办公室、车站和屋顶等都市空间，背: 【Architecture Worldview】Use instantly readable urban spaces such as blocks, shops, schools, offices, stations and rooftops, with backgrounds expressed through geometric planes, perspective lines and limited halftone dots; scenes never compete with character silhouettes or use real brand marks.
【建筑世界观】统一建立山水、村落、亭台、院墙、廊桥、舟船和古道的水墨资产库，以中: 【Architecture Worldview】Build one ink-wash asset library of mountains and rivers, villages, pavilions, courtyard walls, covered bridges, boats and old paths, keeping the world consistent through Chinese structure, near-detail/far-soft focus and ink-value layers; mist, water, clouds and paper white share one negative-space rule.
【建筑世界观】统一使用村庄、森林、阁楼、车站、河岸、市场与小型城堡等可读场景，建: 【Architecture Worldview】Use readable settings such as villages, forests, attics, stations, riverbanks, markets and small castles, with structures leaning toward handmade builds and picture-book perspective; fantasy elements morph from everyday objects, never illogical exotic collage.
【建筑世界观】统一使用高密度亚洲街区、旧楼加建、地下交通、企业塔楼、维修铺、夜市: 【Architecture Worldview】Use dense Asian blocks, additions to old buildings, underground transit, corporate towers, repair shops, night markets and cramped living units, with credible Chinese signage and local fixtures; new tech arrives by retrofitting, overlaying and invading the old city.
【建筑世界观】统一使用环形空间站、舰桥、推进舱、殖民地、轨道电梯和低重力生活区，: 【Architecture Worldview】Use ring stations, bridges, propulsion bays, colonies, orbital elevators and low-gravity living areas, with structures following pressure-hull, maintenance-access, gravity and lighting logic; spectacle serves the scale of civilization, never random alien collage.
【建筑世界观】统一使用几何清晰、层次明确的城市街道、室内、车站、剧院和工业空间；: 【Architecture Worldview】Use geometrically clear, well-layered city streets, interiors, stations, theaters and industrial spaces; walls, glass, masonry, metal and fog are governed by a grayscale material library, with no spectacle backgrounds that carry no narrative.
【建筑世界观】统一使用镜像房间、无尽楼梯、漂浮街道、倒置建筑、空旷大厅和雾中自然: 【Architecture Worldview】Use a spatial grammar of mirrored rooms, endless staircases, floating streets, inverted buildings, empty halls and nature in fog; each impossible space is bound to one narrative rule, never piling random castles and starfields together.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可搭建的微缩住宅、街道、店铺、自然景观与室内布景，结构受真: 【Architecture Worldview】Use buildable miniature houses, streets, shops, natural views and interior sets, with structures constrained by real model scale, lighting rigs and shooting space; backgrounds and props share one scale and handmade language.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可信的中国当代办公室、公寓、咖啡馆、商场、社区和城市公共空: 【Architecture Worldview】Use credible contemporary Chinese offices, apartments, cafés, malls, neighborhoods and urban public spaces, with building scale, furniture systems, Chinese signage and amenities true to local context; places may differ by status but must not turn into Western cities, hollow showrooms or sci-fi futures.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可信的中国近未来实验室、数据中心、交通枢纽、智能住宅、先进: 【Architecture Worldview】Use credible near-future Chinese labs, data centers, transit hubs, smart homes, advanced manufacturing and urban utilities; spaces emphasize structure, maintenance access, wayfinding and equipment scale, with tech upgrades built onto the existing city rather than swapped in from nowhere.
【建筑世界观】统一使用骑楼、旧式住宅、茶餐厅、录像厅、办公室、街市、码头、巴士与: 【Architecture Worldview】Use arcades, old residences, cha chaan tengs, video halls, offices, street markets, piers, buses and dense sign-covered streets, keeping window AC units, tiles, iron shutters, telephones and period vehicles; no smartphones or contemporary street furniture.
【建筑世界观】统一使用山村住宅、林间小屋、农场、茶室、河岸、菜园、集市和小城边缘: 【Architecture Worldview】Use mountain village homes, forest cabins, farms, tea rooms, riverbanks, vegetable plots, markets and small-town edges, keeping wood, stone, earth, old walls, tools and local amenities; buildings must show evidence of region and season.

【建筑世界观】统一使用中国城市中的旧居民楼、楼梯间、地下空间、办公场所、仓储、便: 【Architecture Worldview】Use old residential blocks, stairwells, underground spaces, offices, warehouses, convenience stores, alleys and suburban facilities in Chinese cities, forming a material library of damp walls, glass, metal, concrete and old coatings; all places share the same city region and era.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中国老小区、城中村、普通住宅、学校、医院、工厂、菜市场、公: 【Architecture Worldview】Use old Chinese neighborhoods, urban villages, ordinary housing, schools, hospitals, factories, wet markets, bus stops and county-town streets, keeping cables, laundry, stains, crowded furniture and Chinese public signage; all locations share a definite region, era and economic setting.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中式木构、斗拱、飞檐、瓦当、廊桥、山门、古城、竹林、云海与: 【Architecture Worldview】Use Chinese timber framing, bracket sets, flying eaves, tile ends, covered bridges, mountain gates, old cities, bamboo groves, seas of cloud and an Eastern landscape system to build reusable architecture modules and scene palettes; no European castles, Japanese torii or modern urban elements.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中式木构山门、殿宇、楼阁、城池、洞府、栈道、山水云海和东方: 【Architecture Worldview】Use Chinese timber mountain gates, halls, pavilions, walled cities, cave dwellings, plank roads, landscape cloud seas and Eastern altars, building a module library of bracket sets, roof ridges, tiles, rock and mist; all spectacle evolves from Chinese structure, with no European spires, Gothic churches or random exotic collage.
【角色设计系统】成年角色统一采用约 7 至 8 头身和东方骨相，眼睛比例、脸型、: 【Character Design System】Adult characters use roughly 7–8 heads tall and Eastern bone structure, with eye ratio, face shape, hairline, hair strands, brows and age feel following one character design spec; characters differ through silhouette, height gap, hairstyle and costume structure, and front, side and back references must come from one 2D design.

【角色设计系统】角色采用统一绘本头身、圆润但有差异的轮廓和清晰眼鼻嘴比例，通过帽: 【Character Design System】A unified picture-book head-to-body ratio, rounded yet distinct outlines, and clear eye, nose, and mouth proportions; distinguish by hats, hairstyles, ears, body types, and clothing; front, side, and back views must keep the same hand-drawn traits.
【角色设计系统】角色采用统一头身、眼球、嘴型替换与骨架关节规则，通过鼻形、发型、: 【Character Design System】Unified head-to-body ratio, eyeball, mouth-swap, and skeleton joint rules; distinguish by nose, hairstyle, body type, and clothing silhouette; fingerprints, seams, and swappable mouths may remain, but front, side, and back structures must match and be buildable.

【角色设计系统】角色采用真实东亚骨相和明确阶层差异，义眼、接口、义肢与皮下设备遵: 【Character Design System】Realistic East Asian bone structure and clear class divides, with cybernetic eyes, ports, prosthetics, and subdermal devices from one tech generation; distinguish street characters, corporate staff, and enforcers by silhouette, modification level, wear, and ID marks.
【角色设计系统】角色采用真实东亚面孔、自然年龄与生活状态，保留晒痕、发丝、体态和: 【Character Design System】Realistic East Asian faces with natural age and lived-in states, keeping tan lines, stray hairs, posture, and signs of labor; differentiate by clothing layers, movement habits, hairstyle, and carried objects; no polished advertising-style figures.
【角色设计系统】人物采用稳定头身、脸部勾线、发髻与外轮廓系统，不同角色拥有固定的: 【Character Design System】Stable head-to-body ratio, facial line work, hair buns, and outer contours; each character has fixed brush rhythm, contour traits, and accent colors; detailed near and simplified far is the drawing hierarchy, but no simplification may break character identity.
【角色设计系统】统一采用稳定头身比例、强轮廓、清晰发型和可重复的表情符号；角色通: 【Character Design System】Stable head-to-body ratio, strong silhouettes, clear hairstyles, and repeatable expression symbols; distinguish characters by silhouette, clothing planes, pose, and props; exaggerated expressions must not change the base face shape or identity.

【角色设计系统】选择具有真实年龄、体型、家庭关系和职业痕迹的东亚人物，保留皱纹、: 【Character Design System】East Asian characters with real age, body type, family ties, and occupational traces, keeping wrinkles, tan lines, eye bags, stray hairs, and lived-in states; hair and makeup stay close to daily life; family members resemble each other believably; no influencer faces or styling that defies living conditions.

【项目定位】近未来中国科技题材的写实硬科幻短剧体系，以可推演的技术、清晰功能结构: 【Project Positioning】A realistic hard sci-fi short drama system set in a near-future China, centered on extrapolable technology, clear functional structures, and restrained advancement; the world is 10-30 years ahead of today, and every device, garment, and space must justify its purpose, with no vague sci-fi decoration.

【项目定位】以手工黏土角色和微缩布景制作的定格动画短剧体系，视觉核心是可触摸的材: [Project Positioning] A stop-motion short drama system built with handmade clay characters and miniature sets; the visual core is tactile materials, real model scale, and frame-by-frame performance; keep moderate hand-sculpted marks throughout, and do not disguise it as smooth 3D animation.
【项目定位】以现实人物进入不可能空间为核心的超现实梦境短剧体系，梦境不是随机奇观: [Project Positioning] A surreal dream short drama system centered on real characters entering impossible spaces; the dream is not random spectacle but a traceable visual system built from the characters' memories, desires, fears, and choices; reality and dream segments must have clear differences and rules for returning.
【项目定位】以中国水墨画语言构建的叙事动画项目，统一使用宣纸纤维、干湿笔触、飞白: [Project Positioning] A narrative animation project built in the language of Chinese ink painting, consistently using xuan paper fiber, wet and dry brushwork, flying-white dry strokes, layered ink, broken ink, and light fine-line outlining; hold a balance between poetic empty space and character recognizability throughout, and never treat ink wash as a random filter.

【项目色彩系统】全项目色板使用权重约为 70% 宣纸暖白与留白，20% 焦墨、浓: [Project Color System] The project palette weights roughly 70% warm xuan-paper white and empty space; 20% five-level grays made of scorched, dense, and pale ink; 10% cinnabar, mineral blue, ochre, or project accent colors. Accent colors are assigned fixed duties by character, faction, and key objects, and are not swapped randomly between assets.
【项目色彩系统】全项目色板使用权重约为 70% 自然灰、米白、旧木、土色和水泥色: [Project Color System] The project palette weights roughly 70% natural gray, rice white, aged wood, earth tones, and concrete; 20% environment colors from local walls, furniture, plants, and public facilities; 10% clothing, household items, or project identification colors. The palette may shift with season and region, but always keeps low saturation, natural white balance, and local authenticity.
【项目色彩系统】全项目使用黑、白和五级中性灰作为主色，允许极少量单色强调作为叙事: [Project Color System] The project uses black, white, and five levels of neutral gray as its main colors, allowing a very small amount of monochrome accent as narrative clues; tonal relationships serve character layering and information readability first, and frames must never be crushed into a mass of black or bleached out.
【项目色彩系统】全项目以米白、墨黑和中性灰为结构底色，30% 使用高饱和红、黄、: [Project Color System] The project uses rice white, ink black, and neutral gray as structural base colors, 30% high-saturation red, yellow, blue, or project primary colors, and 10% a single impact color carrying danger, speed, or emotional emphasis; colors must build character and faction recognition.
【项目色彩系统】现实段落使用自然中性灰与低饱和环境色，梦境段落使用 35% 雾白: [Project Color System] Reality segments use natural neutral gray and low-saturation environment colors; dream segments use 35% mist white, pale gold, cold cyan, and dark purple, with 15% fixed symbolic colors carrying character psychology clues; the same symbolic color must not change meaning arbitrarily between characters.
【影像与动态基线】保持柔和但有方向的光影、纸张纹理和有限动画节奏，动作强调呼吸、: [Cinematography and Motion Baseline] Keep soft yet directional lighting, paper texture, and a limited animation rhythm; motion emphasizes breathing, center of gravity, eye direction, and hem follow-through; specific actions and camera staging are decided by the storyboard.
【影像与动态基线】保持深空黑与舱内工作光的层次，使用克制体积光和可信屏幕反射；动: [Cinematography and Motion Baseline] Preserve the layering of deep-space black and interior working light, using restrained volumetric light and believable screen reflections; motion conveys inertia, weightlessness, worn equipment, and spatial limits; specific combat and camera movement are decided by the storyboard.
【影像与动态基线】采用真实日光、阴天漫射、篝火与室内暖灯，允许风、雨、昆虫和环境: [Cinematography and Motion Baseline] Use real daylight, overcast diffusion, campfires, and warm indoor lamps, and let wind, rain, insects, and ambient sound enter the frame; observe characters' small actions and relational pauses, and avoid shooting only pretty empty nature shots.
【影像与动态基线】动作使用速度线、冲击形状、停格姿势和清晰重心，切换节奏由分镜控: [Cinematography and Motion Baseline] Action uses speed lines, impact shapes, held poses, and a clear center of gravity, with rhythm controlled by the storyboard; the camera may mimic comic panel splits, but must never sacrifice the readability of expressions, gestures, and action direction.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持低调但可读的明暗关系、可解释的城市实景光感与克制的心理: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep low-key but readable tonal contrast, believable practical city lighting and restrained psychological tension; movement stays observational, following and oppressive. The Storyboard designs how information is revealed; do not use neon, smoke or camera shake as suspense itself.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持可信体积感、受控特效亮度、真实材质和有重量的动画表现；: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep believable volume, controlled effect brightness, real materials and weighty animation; spells follow a unified shape grammar, particle density, energy color and power tier, and character and environment motion stays consistent. The Storyboard decides the actual combat moves and staging.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持棚内微缩摄影的真实景深、柔和体积光与轻微逐帧节奏，动作: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep the true depth of field, soft volumetric light and slight frame-by-frame rhythm of miniature studio photography; action emphasizes clear key poses, weight and holds. Never mask the stop-motion look with motion blur; the storyboard decides the actual performance.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持清晰剪影、两至三阶角色明暗、工笔场景层次和适度水墨空气: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep clear silhouettes, two to three tonal steps on characters, gongbi scene layering and a subtle ink-wash atmosphere; animation uses clear key poses and limited but accurate 2D motion, with lip sync, hair, hems and effects sharing one animation rhythm. The Storyboard decides the actual action.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持清晰冷静、低噪点和高材质可读性，光源来自顶灯、工作灯、: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep a clean, calm, low-noise look with highly readable materials; light comes from ceiling fixtures, work lamps, screens and natural daylight. Motion emphasizes precise operations, mechanical feedback and spatial order; the storyboard decides camera positions and pacing.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持柔和光感、受控高光、干净轮廓和明快节奏；角色运动统一遵: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep soft light, controlled highlights, clean outlines and a lively pace; character motion follows anticipation, squash and stretch, follow-through, ease in and out, and clear holds, with exaggeration limited by the project performance guide. The Storyboard decides the actual action.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持夜景可读、潮湿反射受控、实景光源有出处，动态兼具街头拥: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep night scenes readable, wet reflections controlled and every practical light motivated; motion blends crowded street energy with corporate spatial order. Rain, smoke and glitches appear only when the story needs them and must not obscure performance or key information.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持自然光感、现场混合色温、适度颗粒与观察式表演，允许真实: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep natural light, mixed on-location color temperature, moderate grain and observational performance, allowing the pauses, repetition and small imperfections of real environments; the style stays plain and close to the characters. No showy cinematography or melodrama that exploits suffering; the storyboard decides staging.
【影像与动态基线】全片保持自然天光、窗纸漫射、烛火与灯笼等时代可信的光感，表演与: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Keep era-credible light from natural daylight, diffused window paper, candles and lanterns; performance and movement follow status etiquette and garment weight. The style is solemn, restrained and physically grounded; the storyboard decides pacing and staging.
【影像与动态基线】全片采用自然光感、可信实景光源、适中的对比度和写实表演节奏；动: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Use natural light, believable practical sources, moderate contrast and realistic performance pacing; the movement is restrained, steady and slice-of-life. The Storyboard may choose static observation or a moving camera per the story, but no unmotivated showy moves or overused slow motion.
【影像与动态基线】全片使用适度胶片颗粒、柔和高光、钨丝灯与窗外冷光的自然混合，动: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Use moderate film grain, soft highlights and a natural mix of tungsten light and cool window light; movement stays handheld-observational with the steady rhythm of classic drama. The Storyboard decides shot sizes, zooms and camera movement.
【影像与动态基线】全片通过墨色浓度、纸白、边缘虚实和点色明度表达光感；动态采用轮: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Express light through ink density, paper white, soft and hard edges and accent-color brightness; motion follows one principle: contour first, brush stroke next, ink growing naturally. Transitions may come from ink drops, brush tips or blank space; the storyboard decides action and staging.
【影像与动态基线】使用硬光、侧光、背光和局部高光塑造戏剧性，允许少量胶片颗粒与光: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Use hard light, side light, backlight and localized highlights for drama, with a little film grain and flare; performance is carried by pauses, eyelines, blocking and bold but believable body language. The Storyboard decides pacing.
【影像与动态基线】现实使用可信光源和稳定镜头，梦境使用慢速漂浮、镜面反射、尺度变: 【Image and Motion Baseline】Reality uses believable light sources and a steady camera; dreams use slow floating, mirrored reflections, scale shifts and discontinuous transitions. Effects stay restrained; the storyboard decides dream actions and beats.
【资产一致性】建立标准角色比例、表情表、材质球、服饰色板、道具比例和建筑模块库；: 【Asset Consistency】Establish standard character proportions, expression sheets, material spheres, costume palettes, prop proportions and a building module library; every new asset must match existing corner radii, roughness, color saturation and detail level.
【资产一致性】建立标准色卡、纸张纹理、笔刷边缘、角色比例、表情表、场景模块和魔法: 【Asset Consistency】Establish a standard color card, paper texture, brush edges, character proportions, expression sheets, scene modules and magic accent-color rules; new assets must match the existing line and grain scale.
【资产一致性】建立灰阶色卡、角色轮廓、帽饰与道具明度表、光影基线和场景构图规则；: 【Asset Consistency】Establish a grayscale color card, character silhouettes, brightness charts for hats and props, a lighting baseline and scene composition rules; a character's costume texture and signature props must stay stable across exposures.
【资产一致性】建立季节色卡、植物与农具库、住宅布局、角色衣橱、手作物件和天气连续: 【Asset Consistency】Establish seasonal color cards, a plant and farm-tool library, house layouts, character wardrobes, handmade objects and weather continuity records; seasonal change should bring visible but gradual asset versions.
【资产一致性】建立家庭成员外貌关系、角色衣橱、生活道具使用痕迹、住宅布局、社区设: 【Asset Consistency】Build an asset library for family resemblance, character wardrobes, wear on everyday props, house layouts, community facilities and regional signage; wear, growth and seasonal change over time must be maintained as continuous versions.
【资产一致性】建立舰船型号、阵营徽记、舱体材质、接口标准、武器尺寸、角色制服和能: 【Asset Consistency】Establish version tables for ship classes, faction insignia, hull materials, interface standards, weapon sizes, crew uniforms and energy colors; every ship upgrade, damage or refit needs a story reason.
【资产一致性】建立角色笔刷、标准墨阶、点色色卡、服饰勾线、建筑结构和自然元素的统: 【Asset Consistency】Establish unified samples for character brushes, standard ink steps, accent color cards, costume linework, building structures and natural elements; new assets must first pass checks on paper texture, stroke scale, grayscale and accent-color roles.
【资产一致性】建立角色标准角度、表情表、线宽、网点密度、拟声字形和动作特效模板；: 【Asset Consistency】Establish standard character angles, expression sheets, line weights, halftone density, sound-effect lettering and action effect templates; all shots share the same line, color block and texture rules.
【资产一致性】建立角色骨架、替换脸、手型、标准色泥、缩尺、布景模块与道具制作表；: 【Asset Consistency】Establish character armatures, swap-out faces, hand shapes, standard colored clay, scale, set modules and a prop build chart; damage, costume changes and expression parts must be maintained per asset version.
【资产一致性】建立角色三视图、宗门色板、服饰拆件、材质球、武器法器、建筑模块、法: 【Asset Consistency】Establish character turnarounds, sect palettes, costume parts, material spheres, weapons and artifacts, building modules, spell templates and a power tier chart; every upgrade, damage or costume change is managed as a causal asset version.
【资产一致性】建立角色线稿规范、标准色卡、表情表、服饰拆件、法术色板、建筑模块与: 【Asset Consistency】Establish character lineart standards, a standard color card, expression sheets, costume parts, spell palettes, building modules and an effects element library; new assets must match line weight, coloring levels and texture density before entering storyboard production.
【资产一致性】建立年代器物清单、角色衣橱、招牌字形、交通工具、室内材质和胶片色彩: 【Asset Consistency】Establish a period prop list, character wardrobes, sign typography, vehicles, interior materials and a film color baseline; the passage of time shows through versions of clothing, hairstyles and city updates.
【资产一致性】建立企业标识、街区导视、义体代际、设备接口、角色改装和服装磨损版本: 【Asset Consistency】Establish versions for corporate marks, district signage, cyberware generations, device interfaces, character mods and costume wear; signage, wiring and spatial relations of the same location stay stable across episodes.
【资产一致性】建立设备型号、接口协议、状态灯职责、角色权限色、服装模块和空间导视: 【Asset Consistency】Establish device models, interface protocols, status-light roles, character permission colors, costume modules and a spatial signage guide; devices of the same class share a structural language, and upgrades and damage form trackable versions.
【资产一致性】建立时代手册、角色衣橱、纹样库、器物库和建筑模块库；同一角色的发饰: 【Asset Consistency】Establish a period guide, character wardrobes, pattern library, prop library and building module library; a character's hair ornaments, garment layers and identity patterns must not change randomly, and set repairs, costume soiling and rank upgrades only update per story versions.
【资产一致性】建立象征色、梦境规则、角色标志物件、空间变形前后对照、镜面材质和转: 【Asset Consistency】Establish symbolic colors, dream rules, character signature objects, before-and-after comparisons of spatial distortion, mirror materials and a transition grammar chart; every distortion maps to a story beat and can be restored.
【资产一致性】为角色建立伤痕与服饰版本，为主要地点建立平面关系、材质板和照明基线: 【Asset Consistency】Build scar and costume versions for characters, floor-plan relations, material boards and lighting baselines for main locations, and unique appearance and state records for key props; cross-episode changes must map to explicit story events.
【资产一致性】为主要角色固定脸型、发型、体型、衣橱编号和常用道具，为主要地点固定: 【Asset Consistency】Lock face shape, hairstyle, build, wardrobe numbers and regular props for main characters, and spatial layout, material boards and signage systems for main locations; cross-episode changes must be driven by story, time or season and recorded in character or scene asset versions.
